}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== "WRTA-151G_V01" and "ENG-d06-0601R RoHS" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos. :This device appears to be identical (besides using the 54Mbps-only AR2315A) to the [[3Com OfficeConnect 3CRWER100-75|3CRWER100-75]].
Default settings (including the SSID) are per the FCC manual.
The power adapter shown in the FCC photos is a '''3Com''' branded '''DVE''' DSA-0151A-12 A w/ '''3Com''' model 3C16760(7900-000-080) (100-120VAC ~ 50/60 Hz, 0.4A -> 12VDC, 1.25A).
